claim: Before enabling the Region deny control, make sure no resources exist in the denied Regions, because you lose access to them, and while it is enabled you cannot deploy resources there.
question: What happens to existing resources in a Region that the Region deny control blocks?

values.display: you will not have access to your resources
you will not be able to deploy resources in the denied Regions

evidence.quote: Before you enable the Region deny control, be sure that you do not have existing resources in these Regions, because you will not have access to your resources after you apply the control. While the control is enabled, you will not be able to deploy resources in the denied Regions.

claim: Proactive controls check resources when they are created or updated through CloudFormation stack operations, so they may not affect requests made directly through the console, APIs, SDKs or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
question: Do proactive controls check resources created outside CloudFormation?

values.display: by means of CloudFormation stack operations
may not affect requests that are made directly to services

evidence.quote: Proactive controls check resources whenever those resources are created or updated by means of CloudFormation stack operations.

As a consequence, these controls may not affect requests that are made directly to services through the AWS console, through AWS APIs, or through other means such as AWS SDKs, or other Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools.

claim: When an account moves from one OU to another, the controls of the previous OU are not removed; controls implemented with SCPs and AWS Config rules must be removed manually.
question: What happens to Control Tower controls when an account is moved to another OU?

values.display: the controls from the previous OU are not removed

evidence.quote: When you move an account from one OU to another, the controls from the previous OU are not removed.
Controls implemented with SCPs and AWS Config rules always must be removed manually when an account changes OUs.
